title: dupatya triangularis
intro: Dupatya triangularis, commonly known as  "Indian gentian" or "gentian root", is a plant species that belongs to the gentian family (Gentianaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Dupatya triangularis are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, improve liver function, and enhance the immune system, making it useful for treating various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include gentiopicroside, gentiin, and loganic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
